{{Top|leg}}
'''Starvision''' was a low-light enhancement module designed for use with the [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blaster]]. In combination with an [[Infrared/Legends|infrared]] module, the E-Web's [[Computer/Legends|computerized]] fire control and [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting systems]] were capable of engaging targets effectively at night.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
